In summary, our research is concerned with

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed methodology provides a new means of knowledge discovery from remotely sensed datasets.
the proposed method can be used to identify the variables that exert inﬂuence on the spatial distribution of a class variable.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method provides a means of discovering and summarizing the knowledge embedded in spatial patterns of remote-sensing datasets.
we have developed a novel method for the discovery and summarization for the spatial patterns that are responsible for the distribution of a given class variable in a remote sensing dataset.

the proposed method provides an efficient way of summarizing remote sensing data, which is a key step toward the development of empirical models that can be used to predict vegetation growth and to monitor changes in the ecosystem.
The main takeaway from our work is that
remote sensing datasets can provide valuable information about the underlying processes that are responsible for the distribution of classes of interest.
remote sensing data can provide a wealth of information that can be used to improve the quality of models of natural phenomena.
the emerging patterns can be used to discover geospatial dependencies between variables, which is a new and important application of the emerging pattern mining.
